title: The Lending Library
description: St. Bertha's runs a free community lending library out of the church basement. Borrow anything, give it back whenever. Sister Glenda explains the terms. Frank just wanted a hedge trimmer, and now he owes the ministry his Tuesdays.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, and tonight, it's all about generosity. Down at St. Bertha's, they run a free community lending library. Borrow a ladder, a casserole dish, whatever you need. Sister Glenda runs the whole thing. Glenda, welcome.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: A free lending library. That's lovely. That's a genuinely nice thing.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Oh, bless you, Ronnie. Yes, anything you need, you just come on down to the basement and you take it. <p:0.3> And then, in your own time, you give a little back to the ministry. No pressure.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You hear that, Barry? No pressure. That's the love of community right there.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Yeah, hi. I borrowed a hedge trimmer. <p:0.3> In April. I would like to understand why I now owe the church forty hours.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Forty hours of what?

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Frank, sweetheart. <p:0.3> A blessing accrues. That's just how a blessing works.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: A blessing does not accrue, Glenda. That's interest. <p:0.3> That's a hedge trimmer with interest.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that's just good stewardship, Barry. You borrow, you give thanks. Thanks compounds.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Oh, hi, Glenda! It's Linda! I borrowed your big punch bowl for the spring social and it was just the most beautiful punch bowl. Could I keep it one more week?

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Of course, sugar. Keep it as long as your heart needs. <p:0.3> The bowl just keeps a little tally, is all.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Oh, a tally! That's so thoughtful. I do love a tally.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: [dissatisfaction-hnn] Linda. Linda, do not love the tally. <p:0.3> The tally is the trap.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, the man with the hedge trimmer sounds genuinely afraid.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Frank's not afraid, Barry. Frank's just behind on his casseroles. <p:0.3> A man falls behind, the casseroles pile up, and pretty soon he owes the whole ministry a hot dish.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: I have made eleven casseroles, Glenda. ELEVEN. <p:0.3> And the balance went UP.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Eleven casseroles for the needy. Frank, that's the most generous thing I've heard all year.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: I am the needy now, Ronnie! <p:0.3> I borrowed ONE trimmer and now I drive a casserole van for the church!

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: And you're so good at it, sweetheart. The van's never run smoother.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: There's a van. Ronnie, why is there always a van.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Glenda. <p:0.3> Glenda, has the new man been told about the ledger in the steeple?

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: The WHAT in the steeple?

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Winston, we are on the AIR. <p:0.3> It is not a ledger, sugar. It is a book of friends.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Everyone in the book of friends is in arrears.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Am I in the book of friends? I would love to be a friend.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: You're on page four now, sugar, on account of the bowl. <p:0.3> Welcome to the friends.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Page four! Oh, I'm moving up!

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: You are not moving UP, Linda, you are going INTO DEBT over a punch bowl!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now Frank, let's not scare the new friend. A little tally never hurt anybody.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Glenda, what happens if somebody just... gives the stuff back and walks away? Clean. Done.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Oh, Barry. <p:0.3> Nobody gives it back. You can only pay it forward. That's the beauty of the ministry.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: A man named Gary tried to give it back. <p:0.3> Gary mows the entire churchyard now. Every Tuesday. Forever.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Tuesday is MY casserole day! <p:0.3> Is Gary the previous hedge trimmer guy? Glenda, am I the new Gary?!

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: You're a better Gary, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, she has a SUCCESSION of Garys. This is a pyramid scheme with a steeple.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's a congregation, Barry. Congregations grow. That's scripture.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: I would like to settle my account. <p:0.3> Today. In full. What do I owe, Glenda. Give me the number.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: There is no number, sugar. <p:0.3> There's only the next casserole.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: [dissatisfaction-hnn] THE NEXT CASSEROLE IS NOT A NUMBER, GLENDA!

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Should I be making casseroles too? I don't want to fall behind the friends.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: RUN, Linda! Give back the bowl and RUN!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: The bowl keeps a tally.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Page five, sugar!

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Page FIVE?!

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: MY TUESDAYS!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: There's a van in the parking lot, Ronnie. <p:0.3> The casserole van. It's outside the station.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well now, would you look at that. <p:0.3> St. Bertha's came to us. That's the love of community, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Ronnie, sugar. <p:0.3> You let us run a whole hour of airtime tonight. <p:0.3> That's a loan. And a loan to the ministry... is a blessing.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: We're on the ledger. Ronnie, we're in the book of friends.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's a free lending library, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: And Frank, sweetheart, before you go. <p:0.3> Gary retired this morning. Bless him. <p:0.3> So I'm gonna need you to start training the next fella. There's a young man borrowed a leaf blower across town. <p:0.3> Doesn't know yet. You're gonna welcome him.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: ...I never borrowed anything.
